evidence.title: Ramps · Color ramps and semantic tokens your agent can read

name: Ramps
summary: Generates OKLCH color ramps and light/dark semantic tokens from a single brand color.
description: A URL-driven palette generator: give it a brand hex and it returns perceptually-even OKLCH ramps (50-950), scheme-derived accents, a matched neutral, status colors and usage-first semantic tokens for light and dark. WCAG AA or AAA contrast is enforced and every token reports its measured ratio. Served as plain text, JSON (API), CSS, Tailwind v4 or Figma variables; free with no account, API key or rate limit.
contains: OKLCH ramps (50-950) generated from one brand color
ramp names: primary, accent, accent-2, neutral, success, warning, error, info
semantic tokens (bg-, text-, border-, ring-) with light/dark mapping
WCAG AA (4.5:1) or AAA (7:1) contrast enforced; measured ratio reported per token
parameters: brand hex, accent scheme, scope, notation, contrast target
JSON API at /api/palette and plain-text pages; no account, key or rate limit
exports: CSS, Tailwind v4, Figma variables, JSON
part of Studio Tools with Springs (motion), Beeps (sounds), Depths (shadows)
